verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Recovery: lines one and two are stated literally — particularGain and signedGain are the paper's two minima, argument for argument and in the paper's order, and particular_gain_eq / signed_gain_eq give equality with 0.4 and 0.4 - κ, which is the display's ≥ together with the fact that the bound is attained. The remaining three lines are stated in margin form rather than as bare inequalities: H - B > 0.1 appears as waveExponent (σ + 1/10) < meanUpdateExponent σ κ, which is equivalent because waveExponent (σ + 1/10) = B + 1/10 (ExponentLedger.wave_increment); likewise min{0.17, 1 - 4κ_s} > 0.1 appears as meanExponent (σ + 1/10) < meanExponent σ + min (17/100) (1 - 4κ) and 0.9 - 4κ_s > 0.1 as meanExponent (σ + 1/10) < meanExponent σ + 9/10 - 4κ, using meanExponent (σ + 1/10) = C_* + 1/10; the identity H - B = 1/2 - 2κ_s and the equality min{0.17, 1 - 4κ_s} = 0.17 are stated separately and literally. Lean assumes κ ≤ 1/100000 and σ ≥ 1/5 where the paper fixes κ_s = 10⁻⁵ and uses B ≥ 0.7, so the Lean statements cover the paper's numbers and more.
